name: view-cart-bar
title: View cart bar
description: A bar pinned to the bottom with item count, total and a View cart button, rising when the first item is added and resting above the footer.
docs: It is sticky, not fixed: render it as the last child of your page's main content, and it stays on the bottom edge of the screen while you scroll, then rests above the footer. total is in minor units. Use hidden on the cart page itself.
